desc: Raised platelet production stops bleeding at the wound site, lessening the trauma of large wounds.
effect: Removes 1 box from any Physical wound of Moderate or higher: a Serious wound marks 5 boxes instead of 6.
The character must take an anticoagulant once a day (20¥ a dose injected, 25¥ oral).
Without it, make a Body (3) Test every twelve hours, +1 for each day missed. No successes means cardiac arrest or aneurysm: Deadly Physical and Stun damage.

desc: Tailored microorganisms in the bloodstream that enhance the body's own regeneration, shortening natural healing time for Physical and Stun damage.
effect: Level 1: heal in 90% of normal time, +50% food and drink.
Level 2: 70% of normal time, +70% food and drink.
Level 3: 50% of normal time, +100% food and drink.
The extra intake means eating more often or a tailored diet at triple normal food cost. With a suprathyroid gland the requirements add together.

desc: Artificially enhanced heart muscle that lets the heart handle strenuous activity with greater ease.
effect: Each level adds 1 die to Athletics-based Success Tests.
Each level adds 1 die to tests to resist cardiac and circulatory conditions.

desc: An energy-diffusing weave grown under the skin that gives the equivalent of personal armor, cumulative with worn armor.
effect: Level 1: +1 Impact. Level 2: +1 Impact, +1 Ballistic. Level 3: +2 Impact, +1 Ballistic.
Add the orthoskin level to the target number of tactile Perception Tests.
Not compatible with dermal plating.
Virtually indistinguishable from normal skin, and damage heals with little or no scarring.

desc: Altered sweat glands release designed pheromones that sway people nearby.
effect: Each level adds +1 to the character's Charisma and Social Skill Tests.
Affects everyone within a circle about 15 to 20 meters across in still air; strong wind disperses it.
No effect on those who cannot smell or on non-humanoid creatures. Halve the effect between different metahuman species.
No effect on astral or conjuring abilities and skills.

desc: A sac on the adrenal glands that sends a surge of adrenaline into the bloodstream when triggered.
effect: While active, each level gives +1 Quickness, +1 Strength, +1 Willpower and +2 Reaction. The Quickness does not also raise Reaction.
Lasts 1D6 turns per level.
When it ends the character resists Deadly Stun damage with Body, at a Power of half the turns it lasted.
Stress, anger or fear trigger it; a Light wound triggers it automatically. Activating or resisting it on purpose takes a Willpower (6) Test.
Takes 10 to 15 minutes to recharge and cannot discharge twice in one encounter.
The Reaction increase does not affect rigging or decking.

desc: A gland implanted on the thyroid that optimizes metabolism and effectively supercharges the recipient.
effect: +1 to Body, Quickness, Strength and Reaction. The raised Quickness can also increase Reaction.
Must eat and drink twice as much as normal, or live on a tailored diet at triple food cost. With symbiotes the requirements add together.
Gives off more heat: observers with thermographic vision get -1 to their target number to notice the character.
Tendency toward hyperactivity. The Reaction bonus has no effect on rigging or decking.

desc: Cultivated liver cells that break down toxins in the bloodstream.
effect: Reduces the Power of a blood-borne toxin attack by 1 for every 2 levels.
Maximum level equals the character's unaugmented Body.

desc: An enhanced spleen producing more effective and aggressive white blood cells.
effect: Reduces the Power of disease, allergen and microbiological attacks by 1 for every 2 levels. It does not work against chemical compounds.
Maximum level equals the character's unaugmented Body.

desc: Additional nervous tissue in the frontal lobes that improves higher-level thinking.
effect: Level 1: +1 Intelligence. Level 2: +2 Intelligence and a Task Pool of 1.
Task Pool dice can be added only to Technical, Knowledge and B/R skill tests, and refresh with the other pools.
Intelligence raised this way can also increase Reaction.

desc: Nerve fibers that bypass the body's safety inhibitors, letting the character act while injured.
effect: No target number or Initiative penalties while damage stays at or below the compensator's level, in boxes.
Physical and Stun damage are judged separately: one track passing the level does not switch off the other.
Once a track exceeds the level, the full penalties for that track apply.
Blocks only the effects of damage, not the damage itself.

desc: Nerve fibers that bypass the body's safety inhibitors, letting the character act while injured.
effect: No target number or Initiative penalties while damage stays at or below the compensator's level, in boxes.
Physical and Stun damage are judged separately: one track passing the level does not switch off the other.
Once a track exceeds the level, the full penalties for that track apply.
Blocks only the effects of damage, not the damage itself.

desc: Nerve fibers that bypass the body's safety inhibitors, letting the character act while injured.
effect: No target number or Initiative penalties while damage stays at or below the compensator's level, in boxes.
Physical and Stun damage are judged separately: one track passing the level does not switch off the other.
Once a track exceeds the level, the full penalties for that track apply.
Blocks only the effects of damage, not the damage itself.

desc: Gray matter grafted to the hippocampus that increases short- and long-term memory.
effect: +1 die per level on Intelligence Tests to recall a specific event or piece of information.
+1 die per 2 levels on Knowledge and Language Success Tests.
Maximum level equals the character's unaugmented Body.

desc: A cluster of nervous tissue that filters out pain when the user switches it on.
effect: While active the character feels no pain, and neither Stun damage nor fatigue can knock them unconscious.
Penalties from Stun damage are ignored. Penalties from Physical damage still apply, tracked by the gamemaster out of the player's sight.
The character does not know their own damage status until the editor is switched off, when all effects apply.
+1 Willpower and -1 Intelligence while active.
+4 to target numbers for tactile Perception Tests while active.

desc: Neural clusters along the spinal cord that memorize one learned skill.
effect: +1 die to all Success Tests with one pre-chosen Concentration of an Active or Vehicle Skill (not B/R). The choice cannot be changed.
Not cumulative on the same skill, but several recorders can cover different skills.
Not compatible with skillwires, and cannot modify a skill supplied by skillwires.

desc: Neural clusters along the spinal cord that memorize one learned skill.
effect: +1 die to all Success Tests with one pre-chosen general Active or Vehicle Skill (not B/R). The choice cannot be changed.
Not cumulative on the same skill, but several recorders can cover different skills.
Not compatible with skillwires, and cannot modify a skill supplied by skillwires.

desc: Lengthened and multiplied nerve cells in the spinal cord that carry signals faster.
effect: Each level adds +1D6 to Initiative.
Incompatible with boosted or wired reflexes; it cannot be combined with either.
The Initiative bonus does not help with rigging or decking.

desc: Receptors at the base of the thalamus that release natural painkillers when the body is hurt.
effect: For each Physical wound, shift one box of the damage from Physical to Stun. For each Stun wound, subtract one box.
+2 to target numbers for tasks that cause the character pain, such as torture; -2 to target numbers to resist pain.
Does not work with an activated pain editor.
With a damage compensator, it works only once the compensator's level has been exceeded.

desc: A rebuilt kidney that filters waste and reclaims useful material more effectively.
effect: +1 to Body for tests to resist toxins and pathogens.
Reduces the Power of pathogen and blood-vectored toxin attacks by 1.

desc: Extra flex in the diaphragm that increases the air moved with each breath, enhancing stamina.
effect: Each level adds 45 seconds to how long the character can hold their breath (about 45 seconds unaided).
Target number modifier on tests of stamina: -1 at Levels 1 and 2, -2 at Level 3.

desc: A sac above the larynx that produces one chosen toxin and expels it as an aerosol.
effect: The toxin is chosen before implantation and cannot be changed.
Quickness (4) Test to hit, +1 to the target number per half meter to the target. Maximum range is half the character's unaugmented Body in meters.
The cone of effect is roughly a triangle two meters on a side.
The character resists that same toxin with double their natural Body.

desc: Filters at the top of the trachea that absorb airborne impurities before they reach the lungs.
effect: Reduces the Power of a non-microbiological airborne attack by half the filter's level (round down).
Impurities of bacterial size and smaller are not affected.

desc: Joint coating, relubrication and tendon augmentation that give extreme fluidity of movement.
effect: Roll 1 additional die on any Success Test involving an Active Skill.
+1 Reaction. The Reaction bonus has no effect on rigging or pure cybernetic decking.

desc: A synthetic fiber braided into the existing muscles, greatly increasing their performance.
effect: +1 Quickness and +1 Strength per level, to a maximum of Level 4.
The added Quickness can increase Reaction.
The bonuses do not affect rigging or decking.
